sourceReadback.supports: World points and reported pose/path; onboard grid decoding with local grid fallback. Does not bind uploaded captures to a revision.
Camera overlay with projected grid, scan rays and separate position estimates; calibration required. Does not establish calibration of the supplied capture.

displayTreatment: Map captures retain original decoded pixels, colours, units and labels. The camera is displayed through responsive WebP delivery previews; its unchanged full-resolution JPEG stays linked. SVG viewBox and clip rectangles expose labelled map detail views. No generative retouching or reconstructed data.
limits: Different captures, not a synchronized or controlled before/after comparison. Screenshot states and counts are what the UI displays, not independently verified accuracy, coverage, safety, physical position or completion. Received date is not a capture date.

deliveryPreviews.treatment: responsive delivery preview; WebP quality 90, method 6; Lanczos resize for 960 px only; original JPEG remains linked unchanged
